---
title: "Day 1 – Open research and the case"
---
Day 1 builds the ground on which the other two days stand: why the reproduction, the robustness and the replication of published results became questions for the field, where the data and the code of studies are kept and found, what SCORE and Multi100 set out to do and how they did it, and the paper of the original author (OA) read in full, with the methods on which its claim rests. The last session installs the tools and downloads the data that days 2 and 3 need.

| Session | What happens | Material |
|---|---|---|
| 1 – Credibility and the three Rs | What a claim is for, why the field speaks of a crisis, and the evidence on reproducibility, robustness and replicability. | [Resources](../../resources.qmd) |
| 2 – Repositories and data sources | Where the data and the code of a study are deposited and how they are found, cited and downloaded; the OSF, Dataverse and the survey archives; SCORE and Multi100, their aims and their designs. | [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd), [Data sources](../../companion/data-sources.qmd), [SCORE and Multi100 on the case study](../../cases/trust/index.qmd#sec-score) |
| 3 – The paper in detail | The paper of the original author (OA) discussed in full: the question, the data, the measures, the models and the claim as SCORE selected it, with the methodological grounding of each choice. | [The original study on the case study](../../cases/trust/index.qmd#sec-study), [the exercise overview](../../cases/trust/exercise.qmd) |
| 4 – Tools and data | R, Quarto and an IDE installed and checked; the workspace of the case downloaded and its check script run; the files of rounds 1 to 4 of the European Social Survey, from the ESS Data Portal at [ess.sikt.no](https://ess.sikt.no), which asks for a free registration. | [Setup](../../setup.qmd), [help](../../help.qmd), [your IDE](../../companion/ide.qmd) |

**By the end of the day** you can say what the claim is and how the paper supports it, where its data and the materials of its reanalyses are kept, and you have a working installation with the workspace and the raw data in place.
